lore:
**The Brown Bear: The Sylvan Monarch**

The Brown Bear—or the *Venerable Ursus* as the mountain-folk name it—claims the untamed fringes of our world. From the mist-shrouded river valleys to the jagged sub-alpine ridges, these titans reign supreme, their presence a heavy weight upon the silence of the woods.

Though they appear lumbering, do not be deceived. A bear possesses a terrifying, explosive grace. They are masters of the "long hunt," often shadowing a scent for leagues with a patience that borders on the supernatural. I have witnessed one pin a thrashing salmon with the delicacy of a seamstress, only to shatter a pine trunk in a fit of territorial pique moments later.

In local lore, the bear is the "Forest’s Justiciar." Woodcutters whisper that the bear only strikes those who disrespect the sanctity of the glade. They are viewed as ancestral spirits clad in hide—ancient sentinels who remember the world before the first stone walls were raised. To encounter one is to stand before the raw, unblinking eye of the wild itself. Tread softly, for in their domain, you are but a fragile guest.
